SELECT T1.Country 
FROM gasstations AS T1 
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 
ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE YEAR(T2.Date) = 2013 AND MONTH(T2.Date) = 6

SELECT T2.Country 
FROM transactions_1k AS T1 
JOIN gasstations AS T2 
ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.Date) = 2013 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T1.Date) = 6

SELECT g.Country 
FROM transactions_1k t 
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID 
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.Date) = 2013 
AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.Date) = 6

SELECT DISTINCT t1.Country 
FROM gasstations t1 
JOIN transactions_1k t2 ON t1.GasStationID = t2.GasStationID 
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t2.Date) = 2013 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t2.Date) = 6

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country 
FROM gasstations AS T1 
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 
ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE YEAR(T2.Date) = 2013 AND MONTH(T2.Date) = 6
